target_problem: an all-instance canonical Range-Avoidance algorithm whose exact runtime and circuit parameters trigger a checked circuit-lower-bound transfer
conditional_implication: If the canonical child comparison N(p0)<=N(p1) can be implemented for every circuit in a checked target class within the transfer theorem's required complexity, then the V92 halving adapter gives a total single-valued avoided-string algorithm in one output model, allowing the remaining transfer parameters to be tested directly.
frontier_reason: V92 closes the semantic and single-valued output bridge, but the Huang-Li-Zhong all-instance evaluator remains exponential in the worst case and no published lower-bound transfer runtime is met.

bridge_lemmas.name: exact low-width prefix counting from V75/V77
one canonical output policy shared by low-width and all-instance evaluators
all-instance child comparison in a transfer-sufficient complexity bound
exact locality, stretch, size, and uniformity parameters of a still-open transfer
nonalgebrizing ingredient when required by the selected route

current_gap: The first missing bridge is runtime and constructivity: high-width instances can force the Huang-Li-Zhong traversed-space representation to size 2^Omega(n), while the inherited arithmetic DAG is polynomial only in the low-width regime. The existential V87 linear-width obstruction does not expose a deterministic certificate capable of deciding the canonical child or producing a single-valued output.
result_obtained: A canonical single-valued halving adapter that makes the inherited low-width prefix-count engine and the published all-instance greedy algorithm return the same avoided output, plus exact finite component-factorization and policy-separation audits.

research_budget_policy.negative_result_status: first-class promotable outcome when stated for a precise certificate model

certificate_gate: A high-width lower bound counts as a positive algorithmic branch only when it yields an input-constructible, efficiently verifiable object with a deterministic map to the canonical child comparison or to a checked transfer-accepted single-valued output. The existential/probabilistic V87 obstruction does not satisfy this gate.
stop_rule: Close the canonical-output interface after V92. V93 receives equal bounded milestones for a constructive high-width certificate and for a rigorous no-go theorem. Continue only a track that produces a quantified formal lemma; otherwise close the high-width certificate front.
external_validation_target: Huang-Li-Zhong ECCC TR25-049 revision 5, Algorithm 4, Theorem 6.2, Claim 6.8, and Theorem 6.11; repository V75, V77, V85, and V87 contracts
next_front: V93 constructive high-width child-count comparison or an equally weighted impossibility theorem for a precise certificate model
